name: Agent Vault
summary: Virtual agent cards and stored logins for AI agents: the agent fills checkout and sign-in forms with mock tokens and real values are substituted out of its view.
description: From Self (spun out of Celo). Agent cards carry per-transaction, daily, weekly or monthly spending caps, merchant allowlists, approval requests and a kill switch. Integrations: a hosted or local MCP server (`@agentvault/mcp`), the `@agentvault/playwright` SDK and an agent skill, plus an open checkout recipe registry. Plans: Free ($0), Plus ($19/month at launch) and Enterprise (contact sales).

agent_access.notes: Hosted MCP server uses browser sign-in; the local MCP server and Playwright SDK use an API key from the dashboard.
